title: A panel takes its title from the book's own distinction — 'Mission Driven vs. Mission Controlled: Who Owns Your Purpose When You Raise?'
summary: Aligned hosts the panel on Thursday 19 November with Wefunder president Jonny Price, Spirit Tech Collective founder Eddy Vaisberg, and Taylor Harrison, an attorney at Virgil who is named here as head of its Incorruptible practice. Littke, Aligned's chief executive, sets it up on the book's mission-controlled governance model. Eric is not speaking.
blockquote: Once you raise, other people get a say in what the company is for, and the financial gravity tends to win out over noble founding ambitions.
blockquote_source: Jonatan Littke, CEO of Aligned, on LinkedIn
